testimonials.author: Sarah Johnson
testimonials.title: Spiritual Transformation
testimonials.content: My life has been transformed through the loving community of Whitefield Methodist Church. The pastors and members have shown me God's love in countless ways.

testimonials.author: Michael Smith
testimonials.title: Finding Purpose
testimonials.content: Through the ministry programs here, I discovered my purpose in serving others. This church has become my spiritual home.

testimonials.author: Maria Garcia
testimonials.title: God's Healing Power
testimonials.content: During my difficult times, the prayer ministry and church family's support helped me experience God's healing and restoration.
